summary: Local acceptance is not complete. The live guest Overworld shows eight regions, and the quick-activation endpoint returns 410. Source review found misleading Daily Care completion behavior, the focused RPG quest-board test fails, and inspected mobile captures show a clipped HUD. Authenticated gameplay was not rerun because this review could not change demo data.

checks.evidence: Headless Chromium loaded http://127.0.0.1:3329/vi/wellness/healthclues/quiz?quest=sleep-better&step=discovery and found data-healthclues-two-question-quiz. node scripts/test-healthclues-discovery-matching.mjs passed 37 assertions.
checks.finding: The two-question click path, primary-focus choice, age gate and Quiz-to-Journey handoff were not exercised in this run.

checks.evidence: Headless Chromium loaded http://127.0.0.1:3329/vi/wellness/healthclues/quiz?step=quest: eight region cards rendered, with two aria-disabled="false" and six aria-disabled="true". src/components/healthclues/HealthCluesQuiz.tsx retains all eight IDs; its CSS references the existing public/healthclues/assets/world/healthclues-world-overworld.webp.
checks.finding: The current guest selector preserves the eight-region, two-playable scope.
No new account was activated or entered into either region during this read-only run.

checks.evidence: node scripts/test-healthclues-region-layout.mjs passed connected-route checks for both regions. src/features/healthclues/RegionMapScene.tsx routes landmark clicks through beginLandmarkTravel.
checks.finding: Actual click, walking animation, painted-road alignment, arrival timing, Talk action, keyboard and touch behavior were not observed in a current authenticated browser session.

checks.evidence: src/features/healthclues/HealthCluesRpgWorldHud.tsx:97-110 and :314-343: only three goals are displayed; toggleGoal changes component-local completedGoals and renders +10 EXP without saving a check-in or updating server XP. The seven-day track uses the count of all distinct check-in dates as its streak.
checks.finding: A Daily Care tap can display completion and an EXP reward without a persisted daily record; reload loses that state. Nonconsecutive historical check-ins can also advance the displayed streak.
Knowledge lessons, quizzes, mini-games and Boss were not opened in an authenticated region during this run.

checks.evidence: GET and POST http://127.0.0.1:3329/api/healthclues/account/quick-activate each returned HTTP 410.
checks.finding: Mailpit activation, return after login, saved progress and two-account isolation were not retested; the 410 result verifies only removal of that bypass.

checks.evidence: Inspected supplied emulated Chromium captures C:\Users\Admin\.gemini\antigravity\brain\bf806726-5fdf-45f1-b574-a2b65a5fbf0f\verified-mobile-320-rpg.png, verified-mobile-390-rpg.png and verified-mobile-430-rpg.png. At 320px the top level capsule extends beyond the right edge; the 390px and 430px captures also cut off top-bar content. These are supplied captures, not fresh screenshots.
checks.finding: The region HUD clips on the requested mobile widths. Quiz, preview, Journey, Daily Care, modal closure, safe-area clearance and physical touch behavior still need fresh visual checks.

checks.evidence: Current GET/POST quick-activate responses were 410. node scripts/test-healthclues-wellness-plan.mjs passed 42 deterministic safety and coverage assertions.
checks.finding: Current-run account isolation, private Plan reads and writes, and health-content provenance were not verified in an authenticated browser. Local fixtures and past reports do not establish reviewed content or production safety.

checks.evidence: node scripts/test-healthclues-rpg-quest-board.mjs exited 1 at line 74: expected the historical Vietnamese goal title, received the selected action title. Discovery matching, region layout and wellness-plan focused tests exited 0.
checks.finding: The focused RPG quest-board regression is red. Its title expectation appears stale against the 2026-11-05 signed-action-title decision; the correct contract and UI behavior need verification before updating the assertion.

blocking_items: Daily Care presents component-local completion and +10 EXP without a persisted check-in, and the seven-day streak counts nonconsecutive dates.
The mobile region HUD clips at the inspected 320px, 390px and 430px widths.
The focused RPG quest-board regression fails on the generated goal-title contract.
Authenticated Quiz-to-World, NPC, learning, persistence and account-isolation paths lack current-run verification.
prompt_for_antigravity: Hãy sửa và nghiệm thu luồng HealthClues trên Owner Demo cô lập tại 127.0.0.1:3329. Màn World/Daily Care: trong src/features/healthclues/HealthCluesRpgWorldHud.tsx, chạm mục tiêu hiện chỉ đổi completedGoals trong React và hiện +10 EXP; tải lại sẽ mất trạng thái. Nối thao tác với luồng check-in riêng tư và XP do server xác nhận, hoặc bỏ dấu hoàn thành/phần thưởng giả và dẫn tới check-in thật. Tính chuỗi 7 ngày theo ngày liên tiếp trong timezone của người chơi, không theo tổng số ngày bất kỳ. Giải thích rõ 5 mục tiêu Journey so với 3 dòng tóm tắt Daily Care và cho truy cập đủ 5 mục tiêu. Màn region HUD mobile: kiểm tra world-adventure.css và topbar/capsule/dock ở 320x800, 390x844, 430x932; sửa phần Level/EXP và nút để không bị cắt, kiểm tra thêm Quiz, World Preview, NPC modal, Journey, Daily Care, safe area, đóng overlay, touch targets và horizontal overflow bằng ảnh mở xem thực tế. Regression: scripts/test-healthclues-rpg-quest-board.mjs đang fail dòng 74 vì kỳ vọng tiêu đề bao quát cũ, còn toAiPlanGoal trả tiêu đề hành động đã chọn; đối chiếu quyết định D-2026-11-05, sửa kỳ vọng và kiểm tra cả tiêu đề mới lẫn bản ghi cũ, giữ xác minh proof ký và trackingDefinition. Sau sửa, chạy focused tests và E2E bằng tài khoản tổng hợp qua Supabase Auth/Mailpit local: chọn từng vùng, Quiz hai câu, bỏ qua Advisor khi chậm, kích hoạt email, vào đúng vùng/Luna hoặc Lumi, click NPC rồi đi đến điểm tiếp cận trước khi Talk, ghi check-in, reload/login, học/mini-game/Boss và thử đọc/ghi chéo tài khoản bị từ chối. Báo URL, lệnh, kết quả, ảnh mở xem và giới hạn; không dùng production, AI thật, dữ liệu thật, không commit/push/deploy hay tự phê duyệt nội dung y tế.
next_test: After repair, rerun node scripts/test-healthclues-rpg-quest-board.mjs, then perform one authenticated local Mailpit Sleep Valley journey with a saved check-in, reload, NPC arrival and 320x800/390x844/430x932 visual inspection.
